ledger: Large glass jar | empty at 00:00 (clear bottom visible) | filled ~half with mixed green and dark-brown olives by 00:09 | dark-brown olives present at 00:01 though only green olives were being poured from the small bowl

Right light-colored bowl on counter | green olives at 00:00 | green olives, roughly unchanged through 00:09 | no notable transitions

findings.description: At 00:00 the jar is visibly empty and the small bowl being poured contains only green olives. At 00:01, while a green olive is still falling from the bowl, several dark-brown/purple olives have already appeared at the bottom of the jar. These dark olives were never poured on camera and cannot be accounted for (they sit beneath the still-falling green ones, which also contradicts the pour order if the bowl had contained a mix).
